thread:
Maria G.: Noticed confusion in the Models panel: UI label = 'Model display name' but docs and API use `model_id`. Support is getting multiple tickets asking which to supply.

Alex P.: Seen it too. We should align terminology. Prefer keeping API canonical term (`model_id`) but show friendly label in UI.

Jordan L.: UX suggestion: keep 'Model display name' but add a one-line helper: 'API identifier: `model_id` (used in requests)'. Must be connected to the input via aria-describedby.

Samir K.: Implementation note: helper + aria is quick. Renaming labels across components is larger. Recommend helper + docs link first.

Maria G.: Action: 1) add helper copy + inline link to docs, 2) docs add anchor & short mapping, 3) follow up on rename if support volume stays high. Owners: Alex (copy + docs PR), Jordan (a11y), Samir (dev).

docs-bot: @alexp opened PR https://gh.internal/redwood/docs/pull/450 adding 'Model identifiers' anchor and mapping table.

Alex P.: Draft helper copy: "Model display name — friendly label. API identifier: `model_id` (used in API/CLI). Learn more about model identifiers (opens docs)." Will add link to /docs/console/models#identifiers.

Jordan L.: Small a11y asks: 1) ensure helper text contrast, 2) aria-describedby linking, 3) link text descriptive. I'll run keyboard tests on staging.

Samir K.: CSS focus tweak I'll add: `.panel-helper a:focus { outline: 3px solid #0366d6; outline-offset: 2px; }`. Estimate ~2 dev-hrs.

Alex P.: Also adding a small CLI alias note in the docs so `--model-id` and `--model-name` are shown in help.

Maria G.: Sounds good. Ship helper + docs link this week, monitor support. Thanks everyone.
